items.summary_en: Wellington's deputy mayor says fixing the city's poor pipes could cost each ratepaying household or business more than $80,000 over the next 25 years. The warning highlights the huge price of repairing aging underground infrastructure.

items.raw_excerpt: It’s been just a week since the Reykjavík International Film Festival wrapped up, and there’s already another film event on the horizon. Live music, creative workshops…

items.summary_en: Opposition lawmakers walked out of the Kerala state assembly. They protested police action at a university hostel. The session saw a debate, a baton dispute, and protest violence.

items.raw_excerpt: Imagens mostram policiais tentando parar o veículo no bairro Parolin. Ninguém ficou ferido, segundo a Polícia Militar (PM-PR).
items.summary_en: A police car rolled down a hill on its own during a stop in the Parolin neighborhood of Curitiba. Security cameras showed officers chasing the vehicle but failing to stop it. Police said only property damage was reported and no one was hurt.
items.summary_ko: 쿠리티바 파롤린 지역에서 순찰차 한 대가 정차 중 혼자 경사길 아래로 굴러 내려갔다. 방범 카메라에는 순찰차를 세우려 쫓아가는 경관들의 모습이 담겼지만, 차를 멈추지는 못했다. 경찰은 재물 피해만 발생했고 다친 사람은 없다고 밝혔다.
items.title_en: Police Car Rolls Down Hill Alone During Stop in Curitiba

items.raw_excerpt: Two former MPs for New Social Contract have resigned in protest at the party’s decision to invite right-wing independent MP Mona Keijzer to a weekend conference. Harm Holman, NSC’s former agriculture spokesman, and Ilse Saris, who covered social affairs, said they no longer felt at home in a party that was drifting towards right-wing populism. Saturday’s general meeting in Breda ended in chaos when the party’s entire management board resigned following a mass walkout when Keijzer stepped up onto
items.summary_en: Two former MPs for the Dutch party New Social Contract have quit in protest. They are unhappy that the party invited right-wing MP Mona Keijzer to a weekend meeting. The whole party board quit after many members walked out in Breda.
items.summary_ko: 네덜란드 신사회계약당의 전직 의원 두 명이 당의 주말 행사 결정에 반발해 탈당했다. 이들은 우파 무소속 의원 모나 케이저를 초대한 데 불만을 풀었다. 브레다에서 열린 총회에서는 회원들이 대거 퇴장해 당 전체 지도부가 사퇴했다.

items.raw_excerpt: Jun Takahashi was stunned when he saw the online post: someone in the Yukon bush had found a canoe barrel full of his mildew-y camping gear, and his long-lost flute.
items.summary_en: A canoe barrel full of mildew-y camping gear and a long-lost flute was found in the Yukon bush. Jun Takahashi was stunned to see the online post. His flute floated away down a Yukon river five years ago.
items.summary_ko: 요컨의 숲에서 캠핑 장비가 든 카누 통과 잃어버렸던 피리가 발견됐다. 준 다카하시는 온라인 게시물을 보고 깜짝 놀랐다. 그의 피리는 5년 전 요컨 강을 따라 떠내려갔다.

items.summary_en: The Alentejo region is offering €3.5 million to small and medium businesses to hire skilled workers. Applications for this funding will stay open until March 2027.

items.summary_en: Chilean footballer Darío Osorio was not in the squad for the game against Nottingham Forest. Crystal Palace won the Premier League match. A report explains why he did not play.

items.raw_excerpt: Maile says the Department is ready to administer the National Senior Certificate examinations
items.summary_en: Gauteng's Education Department says it is ready to use special scanners during the National Senior Certificate exams. The scanners are meant to stop students from cheating. The move aims to keep the exams fair.
items.summary_ko: Gauteng 주 교육부는 고교 졸업시험을 치르는 동안 특수 스캐너를 투입할 준비가 되었다고 밝혔다. 이 스캐너는 수험생의 부정행위를 막기 위한 장치다. 당국은 시험이 공정하게 유지되도록 조치를 마련했다.

items.raw_excerpt: Minister Dean Macpherson says the department wants the court to prevent further occupation.
items.summary_en: South African Minister Dean Macpherson said his department wants a court to stop further unlawful occupation in Knoflokskraal. The move aims to prevent more people from taking the land or property without permission.

items.raw_excerpt: "Chupete" fue cauto tras la victoria ante Puerto Montt.
items.summary_en: Chilean footballer Humberto Suazo says his team has had a great year after beating Puerto Montt. His club now leads the Ascenso, Chile's second division. Suazo says the team must keep working hard.
items.summary_ko: 칠레 축구 선수 움베르토 수아소는 푸에르토몬트를 이긴 뒤 좋은 한 해를 보냈다고 말했다. 그의 팀은 현재 칠레 2부 리그 아센소에서 선두를 달리고 있다. 수아소는 팀이 계속 노력해야 한다고 강조했다.

items.raw_excerpt: A community-owned pub in North Yorkshire has reached the final four in CAMRA's National Pub of the Year 2026 competition.
items.summary_en: A community-owned pub in North Yorkshire has been named a finalist in CAMRA's National Pub of the Year 2026 contest. It is now one of only four pubs left in the running. The small village pub is run by local people who bought it together.
items.summary_ko: 노스요크셔의 한 공동체 소유 펍이 CAMRA가 주관하는 전국 올해의 펍 2026 대회 최종 후보로 선정됐다. 이 펍은 현재 결승에 오른 4개점 중 하나다. 마을 주민들이 함께 구매해 운영하는 작은 펍이다.
